subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Privacy is not only about hiding secrets.”?
options: Sometimes it is a sign that people care about different parts of the same story.
It is about choosing what parts of life should remain under personal control.
Sometimes it means choosing which parts must remain and which parts must change so a place can live again.
How people say goodbye reflects what they believe about life, nature, and responsibility.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Sometimes it is a sign that people care about different parts of the same story.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Privacy is not only about hiding secrets. It is about choosing what parts of life should remain under personal control.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Sometimes it means choosing which parts must remain and which parts must change so a place can live…」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「How people say goodbye reflects what they believe about life, nature, and responsibility.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Privacy is not only about hiding secrets. It is about choosing what parts of life should remain under personal control.」，答案為「It is about choosing what parts of life should remain under personal control.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「It is about choosing what parts of life should remain under personal control.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
